rationale.formal-methods: Symbolic execution establishes bounded semantic equivalence among generated programs.
rationale.rules-based-checks: CrossHair deterministically clusters outputs using bounded symbolic equivalence checks.
rationale.risk-routing: Learned thresholds decide whether generated solutions are shown or withheld.
rationale.built-system: Authors implemented symbolic clustering with CrossHair and evaluated it.
rationale.agentic: Models generate complete programming solutions as wholesale reviewable artifacts.
rationale.metrics: Defines and validates symbolic cluster count as a quality metric.
rationale.risk-quality: Measures functional correctness and gates likely incorrect generated code.
rationale.method-experiment: Controlled benchmark compares models, clustering methods, and abstention policies.
